k01.summary: Fluorine chemistry is a shared industrial foundation for battery salts, selected mineral-purification routes and electronic chemicals. India's existing HF plants provide a starting point, but each application needs its own process, purity controls and customer qualification.

what.text: Hydrogen fluoride, HF, is the main industrial starting material for many fluorine compounds. Anhydrous HF contains essentially no water; hydrofluoric acid is HF dissolved in water. These are different products with different handling and process requirements. In the conventional route, acid-grade fluorspar, containing calcium fluoride, reacts with sulphuric acid: CaF2 + H2SO4 → 2HF + CaSO4. The useful product is recovered from a gas stream, rather than simply filtering an acid from crushed ore.

The transferable capability is the ability to make, purify and handle fluorine chemicals in equipment that resists corrosion, controls moisture and contains emissions. It is not a ready-made graphite refinery or semiconductor chemical business. BUSS ChemTech separately offers technologies for HF, lithium fluoride and LiPF6: sharing a chemical family does not remove the need for a dedicated process at each step.

value_chain.name: Fluorspar → crude HF
value_chain.description: Dry and prepare acid-grade calcium-fluoride feed, react it with concentrated sulphuric acid in a heated reactor, then collect the HF-bearing gas. Calcium sulphate remains as a solid coproduct. Feed moisture and impurity management affect corrosion and purification loads.

value_chain.name: Crude HF → specified HF grade
value_chain.description: Condensation, scrubbing and distillation separate HF from water and volatile contaminants. Industrial AHF is an intermediate. Electronic wet chemicals add application-specific purification, dilution or blending and clean delivery; a bulk HF assay alone does not demonstrate wafer-process suitability.

value_chain.name: HF → battery and metallurgical chemicals
value_chain.description: Lithium fluoride and phosphorus-fluorine chemistry support LiPF6 electrolyte salt production. A different branch converts already-separated rare-earth compounds into fluorides for metal production. Neither branch produces lithium ore or separates a mixed rare-earth deposit into individual elements.

value_chain.name: HF → purification and surface treatment
value_chain.description: In graphite processing, HF attacks silicate-rich impurities; the purified carbon still needs particle shaping, coating and battery testing. In electronics, high-purity HF and buffered fluoride mixtures etch or clean selected surface films. The application consumes a process reagent rather than incorporating HF as the device's active mineral.

mineral_links.fit: Downstream process chemical

That supports a narrow process connection, not a claim that HF produces gallium metal or that a supplier is qualified for a commercial GaN fabrication line.
mineral_links.fit: Application-specific adjacency

expansion.title: Choose a product and a buyer before adding capacity
expansion.text: Build separate cases for industrial HF, electronic wet chemicals and battery-salt intermediates. Each case should identify feedstock, delivered specification and the customer trial required. The Orbia–Kanto Denka licensing model suggests that combining Indian plant-operating experience with licensed process know-how is plausible; ownership of HF assets alone is insufficient.

expansion.title: Pilot the mineral connection on real material
expansion.text: For graphite, test representative Indian concentrates and measure impurity removal, carbon recovery and waste generation before selecting an HF route. For rare earths, start with a specific separated oxide and a metal maker's specification. Compare alternative salt-preparation routes: Ames researchers demonstrated neodymium metal using a fluoride precursor prepared without HF in 2025, still a research result rather than an established Indian plant.

expansion.title: Expand what passes qualification
expansion.text: Prioritise repeatable saleable batches, traceable quality and practical delivery arrangements. The economic question is the cost of accepted product, including rejected material and treatment costs. Navin's ₹450 crore disclosure concerns its specific AHF project; it is not a defensible capital estimate for a semiconductor HF line or an integrated LiPF6 complex.

constraints.title: Containment is part of the process
constraints.text: Gas cleaning, corrosion control and moisture exclusion must be designed into the plant. These affect reliability and operating cost, not just compliance. Equipment suitable for one concentration or water content cannot be presumed suitable for every fluoride service.

constraints.title: A chemical relationship is not a complete supply chain
constraints.text: Fluorination does not solve rare-earth separation, graphite particle engineering or semiconductor fabrication. The opportunity is to supply a missing intermediate within a larger chain; its value depends on whether the neighbouring operations and buyers exist.

k02.summary: Battery electrolyte is an engineered liquid that carries lithium ions and helps control electrode surfaces. India can make salts, formulate electrolyte and support cell qualification as separate businesses; progress in one does not automatically establish the others.

what.text: A lithium-ion cell stores energy in its electrodes. During charging and discharging, lithium ions travel through an electrolyte while electrons move through the external circuit. In a conventional liquid electrolyte, a lithium salt such as LiPF6 dissolves in organic carbonate solvents. The solvent surrounds the lithium ions and changes how easily they move. Argonne's X-ray studies show why a mixture's microscopic behaviour matters: electrolyte is more than a liquid carrier chosen by price alone.

Salt, solvent, additive and finished electrolyte are different products. The salt supplies conducting ions; solvents determine transport and dissolution; small quantities of additives influence reactions at electrode surfaces. MU Ionic Solutions designs formulations around customer performance requirements and uses additive know-how to suppress unwanted reactions. A formulation for one cell design cannot simply be presumed suitable for a different cathode, anode, voltage or temperature range.

The electrode remains a separate manufacturing problem: LiPF6 is not lithium iron phosphate cathode powder, and electrolyte blending is not lithium mining or cathode production. LiPF6 also has moisture and thermal limitations. Freiburg's electrolyte research identifies hydrolysis that can form HF and thermal decomposition as motivations for developing alternative conducting salts. This makes dry processing and chemical stability central to production and storage.

value_chain.name: Lithium and fluorine inputs → conducting salt
value_chain.description: Obtain suitable lithium and fluorine-based intermediates, manufacture and purify the chosen salt, and validate it for the customer's electrolyte process. LiPF6 uses lithium, phosphorus and fluorine; a salt plant is a chemical conversion asset, distinct from the formulation plant that consumes its output.

value_chain.name: Organic chemicals → specified solvents and additives
value_chain.description: Secure the required carbonate solvents and functional additives at suitable purity. EC, DEC, EMC and related molecules affect ion solvation differently; a chemically similar substitute can change the finished electrolyte's behaviour.

value_chain.name: Salt + solvents + additives → electrolyte formulation
value_chain.description: Prepare the prescribed blend, protect its quality during handling and deliver a consistent product. A formulator can buy its salt rather than manufacture it. Soulbrain's model combines inventories of high-purity ingredients with customised development and production batches.

value_chain.name: Electrolyte → approved cell design
value_chain.description: The buyer evaluates the formulation in the actual cell. The supplier must connect ingredient specifications with cycle performance, gas generation and the intended operating conditions. Audits and provisional approval are intermediate milestones: Neogen's July 2026 disclosure explicitly places commercial salt supplies after final plant-trial approvals.

expansion.title: Begin with customer-linked formulation
expansion.text: A plausible expansion begins with a small number of actual cell programmes and locally supplied development batches. Initially buying qualified salt and solvents can separate learning about formulation and delivery from the risks of commissioning a salt reactor. The commercial asset is the ability to troubleshoot alongside the buyer and reproduce an approved blend, illustrated by Soulbrain's custom-development model.

expansion.title: Add salt capacity against specific demand
expansion.text: Develop salt manufacture where feed availability, process know-how and committed demand support it. Neogen's public sequence—commissioning, trial production and buyer approval—provides more useful milestones than treating announced tonnes as immediately saleable supply. Keep separate records for installed equipment, qualified capacity, repeat orders and actual output; track electrolyte and salt independently.

expansion.title: Build application expertise before broadening the portfolio
expansion.text: Use joint testing with cell makers to identify which additives and solvent grades genuinely need localisation. Research alternatives to LiPF6 where the target application justifies them, while validating stability, compatibility and production economics. A stronger Indian capability could eventually serve domestic cells and export markets, but it requires customer acceptance rather than assuming all announced gigafactories become orders.

constraints.title: Chemical purity does not replace cell validation
constraints.text: Impurity control matters, but the buyer also needs the full formulation to behave correctly at both electrodes. A laboratory sample that passes a chemical assay is therefore one milestone; a durable, reproducible cell result is another.

constraints.title: Do not divide a combined project cost by one product's tonnes
constraints.text: Neogen disclosed ₹1,795 crore for its Dahej Phase 1 and Pakhajan Phase 2 battery-material projects together in July 2026. Their scope spans multiple products and sites. This is context for the investment programme, not a stand-alone per-tonne estimate for electrolyte blending or LiPF6 synthesis.

constraints.title: Local formulation can still depend on imported ingredients
constraints.text: A domestic blend changes where the final liquid is made; it does not establish the origin of its lithium, salt, solvents or additives. Supply resilience should be evaluated ingredient by ingredient, with more than one acceptable source where the cell specification permits.

k03.summary: India's fertiliser-acid infrastructure and specialist iron-phosphate chemistry can support an LFP materials chain. The missing steps must be assessed separately: purified acid, engineered FePO4 precursor and qualified lithium iron phosphate cathode powder are different products.

what.text: Phosphate chemistry turns phosphorus-bearing rock into acid and useful phosphate compounds. A fertiliser plant needs acid that meets its fertiliser process requirements. A battery-materials producer needs a controlled impurity profile and repeatable precursor behaviour. Concentrating an acid removes water; purifying it separates unwanted substances. High acid strength therefore does not by itself establish battery suitability.

The main battery connection is lithium iron phosphate, LiFePO4 or LFP. Its phosphorus-containing framework hosts lithium that moves in and out during cycling. Iron phosphate, FePO4, is an upstream precursor rather than the completed cathode. One industrial route combines FePO4 with lithium carbonate and a carbon source, then mixes, mills, dries and heat-treats the material. The finished powder must have the right chemistry and physical properties for electrode manufacture.

This is partly a particle-engineering business. Small particles shorten lithium transport distances, but excessively fine material can compromise packing and slurry handling. Sudeep describes controlling precipitation, drying, surface characteristics and particle classification. Experience making pharmaceutical iron phosphate can help, but it must be translated into cathode performance rather than treating pharmaceutical and battery specifications as equivalent.

value_chain.name: Phosphate rock + sulphuric acid → wet-process acid
value_chain.description: Digest prepared rock with sulphuric acid, crystallise calcium sulphate and filter it from the acid. Wash solids to recover entrained acid, then concentrate the liquid. This creates a large gypsum stream and requires fluoride-emission and water management.

value_chain.name: Merchant acid → purified phosphoric acid
value_chain.description: Remove unwanted contaminants and separate the required acid product; solvent extraction is an established purification route. Alternatively, thermal acid starts with elemental phosphorus, which is oxidised and hydrated. These are different flowsheets: thermal acid is not just a cleaner operating mode of the fertiliser digester.

value_chain.name: Purified phosphate + iron source → FePO4
value_chain.description: Produce iron phosphate with controlled composition, particle distribution and morphology; separate, wash and dry it consistently. The precursor's structure and impurities influence what the later LFP process can achieve. A qualified acid feed alone is therefore insufficient.

value_chain.name: FePO4 + lithium source + carbon → LFP cathode material
value_chain.description: Combine precursor, lithium and carbon inputs through the selected synthesis and heat-treatment route. Carbon surface modification can improve conductivity. Cathode powder then goes into electrode and cell manufacture; successful powder production does not establish a qualified cell.

expansion.title: Qualify existing precursor production first
expansion.text: Use small, traceable FePO4 batches with a specific LFP producer. Evaluate precursor chemistry alongside particle behaviour and cell results; establish which properties must remain stable between batches. Sudeep's upgraded line creates a plausible starting platform, but the performance of new downstream formulations still requires buyer testing.

expansion.title: Test acid purification on an identified feed
expansion.text: A domestic purification project should start with a contracted acid or rock stream and impurity analysis, then pilot the treatment and establish acid recovery and waste disposition. It may initially be rational to import qualified PPA while building precursor demand. The First Phosphate–Prayon work illustrates the need to demonstrate the actual rock-to-acid route before extrapolating from an acid plant's size.

expansion.title: Link precursor, cathode and cell projects through trials
expansion.text: Co-development between Indian FePO4, LFP and cell producers could reveal whether a local precursor works in a customer's manufacturing line. Expand against repeat orders and demonstrated yields; retain the distinction between precursor tonnes and finished cathode tonnes. Cathode synthesis, coating and electrode processing should have separate acceptance milestones, even where one group owns several steps.

constraints.title: Acid concentration and acid purity are different
constraints.text: P2O5 is often the reporting basis for phosphoric-acid capacity, rather than tonnes of acid solution. Comparing a P2O5 capacity with tonnes of FePO4 or LFP without conversion is misleading. Further concentration cannot substitute for removing the contaminants that matter to the chosen product.

constraints.title: Impurities and particle structure both matter
constraints.text: A 2025 experiment found that different FePO4 impurities affected LFP differently; some controlled magnesium improved performance in the tested formulation. The goal is a specified, reproducible impurity profile, rather than the highest aggregate purity at any cost. Particle engineering likewise balances transport, packing and processing.

constraints.title: Do not turn development milestones into operating supply
constraints.text: Pilot output, upgraded nameplate capacity, a project under construction and a customer-qualified commercial line represent different levels of evidence. Indian expansion is credible precisely because these intermediate steps exist; counting all announced capacity as current output would conceal the remaining work.

k04.summary: A reusable separation skill: move selected molecules or metal ions between two liquids, then recover a purified product. India has chemical equipment suppliers and actual mineral-separation operators; transferring pharmaceutical experience to a new mineral still requires a qualified flowsheet.

what.text: Liquid–liquid extraction separates dissolved substances that a filter cannot catch. Two liquids that remain as separate phases are mixed so the desired substance transfers preferentially into one of them, then allowed to separate again. An extractant is the chemical that provides this preference; the solvent system also needs a suitable carrier liquid. Selectivity is the valuable part: recovering one saleable substance from the mixture.

In mineral refining, extraction is followed by scrubbing, which removes unwanted co-extracted species, and stripping, which transfers the product into a fresh liquid. The extractant can return to the circuit. For similar rare-earth ions, a small preference at one contact must be amplified through a designed sequence of contacts. The difficult asset is the complete operating flowsheet, including acidity, impurities and recycle streams, rather than a mixing vessel alone.

Pharmaceutical and agrochemical manufacturing supplies relevant experience in solvent handling, phase separation and corrosion-resistant equipment. It does not automatically supply rare-earth separation factors, a stable multistage cascade or metal-product qualification. Sudeep is a more concrete example of adjacent capability: its August 2026 filing reports an existing pharmaceutical iron-phosphate line upgraded for battery materials. That is evidence of chemical-product transfer, not proof that the company operates rare-earth extraction.

value_chain.name: Feed solution → clarified, conditioned liquor
value_chain.description: A mineral concentrate or recycled material first needs dissolution and impurity control. IREL receives mixed rare-earth chloride concentrate at Aluva; its listed outputs include Nd-Pr, Sm, Gd and Y oxides. The extraction section therefore sits between making a mixed solution and delivering separated compounds.

value_chain.name: Mixed liquor + organic phase → loaded extract + raffinate
value_chain.description: Mixer-settlers or extraction columns provide contact and phase separation. The loaded organic carries extracted material; raffinate is the liquid left behind. Equipment must be selected for the actual chemical mixture and duty, including corrosion and flammability requirements.

value_chain.name: Loaded organic → scrubbed material → stripped product solution
value_chain.description: A sequence of extraction, cleanup and stripping establishes the split. NFC provides an Indian industrial example: TBP in kerosene selectively extracts zirconium from nitric-acid feed, leaving hafnium in the aqueous stream; zirconium is then stripped back into water.

value_chain.name: Purified solution → oxide or acid → customer material
value_chain.description: Rare-earth products can be precipitated and calcined into oxides. Phosphoric acid uses a different flowsheet: wet-process acid is purified to remove unwanted material before downstream phosphate manufacture. Tenova markets dedicated solvent-extraction technology for this duty; phosphate chemistry should not inherit a rare-earth plant design.

expansion.title: First: choose a product and secure representative feed
expansion.text: Proposed pathway: begin with either a defined rare-earth split at an experienced mineral operator or a phosphate-acid purification project. Set feed-composition limits and a customer specification before buying extraction equipment. Test variability and recycling streams; average feed chemistry alone is insufficient for designing a reliable circuit.

expansion.title: Then: prove continuous operation and customer acceptance
expansion.text: Proposed pathway: use Indian equipment and analytical suppliers around a specialist process team. Run a continuous pilot long enough to observe solvent losses, impurity accumulation and product consistency. Expand only after customer samples meet specification. This links adjacent manufacturing skills to a proven mineral flowsheet without treating sector size as proof of readiness.

expansion.title: Finally: add selective products rather than every element at once
expansion.text: Proposed pathway: match a phased product basket to contracted feed and buyers. Solvay’s operating model illustrates partnerships with mining and recycling suppliers. A commercially useful Indian expansion might start with a small number of saleable products and add harder splits once their feed and offtake are demonstrated.

constraints.title: Similar ions and mixed products
constraints.text: Rare-earth chemistry does not guarantee an economical split between every pair. IREL’s own register gives different development projects different maturity levels. Reporting all rare-earth names as one established capability hides the difference between making a mixed intermediate and consistently supplying separated products.

constraints.title: Specification, waste and economics
constraints.text: Project appraisal must include acid and base consumption, solvent replacement, contaminated aqueous streams and actual product acceptance. Prayon offers different impurity-removal treatments for different contaminants, illustrating why “purified” is not one universal specification. No comparable public Indian extraction-plant cost was established here; pharmaceutical-sector scale is not a cost benchmark.

k05.summary: Selective resin beads capture dissolved ions, then release them into a cleaner stream. India manufactures resins and has a gallium-recovery demonstration project, but each mineral application needs its own chemistry, feed testing and operating evidence.

what.text: An ion-exchange resin is a solid, usually a cross-linked polymer bead, carrying chemical sites that interact with dissolved ions. Liquid flows through a packed bed: some ions remain on the bead while others pass through. When capacity is exhausted, another solution releases the captured ions and prepares the resin for reuse. This is a chemical separation, not ordinary filtration of suspended particles.

Selectivity matters more than the mere ability to capture a metal. A general resin may collect many competing ions; a chelating resin uses specific binding groups, while an impregnated resin carries a selective extractant within a solid support. Choosing a product requires knowing the metal’s chemical form, the acid or caustic medium and all major competitors. Ion Exchange India’s catalogue lists distinct media for distinct metal-recovery and acid-cleanup duties.

Several different jobs are often conflated: capture a dilute metal, remove impurities from an already concentrated solution, or separate similar metals from one another. They demand different process designs. DuPont’s lithium guidance is a useful warning: conventional cation resin has weak relative affinity for lithium, so salt-removal capability is not evidence of selective lithium extraction from a brine.

value_chain.name: Process liquor → resin-ready feed
value_chain.description: Start with Bayer liquor for gallium, a residue leachate for scandium or a brine/intermediate for lithium. Remove or manage solids and competing impurities before the selective stage. A 2024 scandium study used actual bauxite-residue leach solution and found different column behaviour from its cleaner simulated solution.

value_chain.name: Conditioned feed → loaded resin + depleted liquid
value_chain.description: Column loading concentrates a target ion on the bead. Measure the breakthrough curve: it shows when metal begins escaping rather than assuming a fresh-resin laboratory capacity persists in service. Resin choice, flow, acidity and contaminant loading determine useful capacity.

value_chain.name: Loaded resin → eluate + regenerated bed
value_chain.description: Wash and elute the bed to recover a more concentrated solution, then return it to service. For rare-earth chromatography, carefully chosen eluents can produce separate element bands, with mixed fractions recycled. This may deliver purity at the expense of liquid volume and cycle time.

value_chain.name: Eluate → purified salt, oxide or metal
value_chain.description: Capture is not the final product. Lithium still needs concentration and chemical conversion; gallium needs further recovery and high-purity refining; scandium solutions need downstream product isolation. DuPont’s 2026 DLE portfolio explicitly combines selective adsorbents, membranes and polishing resins across different duties.

k06.summary: Chloride chemistry makes otherwise difficult-to-purify elements transportable as chemical intermediates. India already applies it to titanium and nuclear zirconium; chlorosilanes for polysilicon demand a separate technology and purity system.

what.text: Chlorination converts an oxide feed into a chloride intermediate. For titanium, chlorine and carbon convert titanium-bearing feed into crude titanium tetrachloride, TiCl4. Turning the element into a transportable chemical lets the refinery separate impurities before converting it back into pigment or metal. Chloride chemistry is therefore a processing bridge: the customer usually wants titanium dioxide or titanium metal, rather than chlorine in the final material.

Silicon uses hydrogen chloride to make trichlorosilane, which is distilled and deposited as high-purity silicon. Its flowsheet, equipment and quality requirements differ from a titanium-chloride circuit. This is an adjacent technology connection, not evidence that a TiCl4 producer already makes polysilicon.

India’s strongest transfer is direct within titanium: pigment-grade TiCl4 already exists at KMML and is further purified for sponge production. Chlor-alkali and bulk-acid experience can provide supporting utilities and handling skills, but it cannot be counted as nuclear Zr-Hf separation or semiconductor-quality silicon production. The missing intellectual property is often selective purification and reliable impurity control rather than simply obtaining chlorine.

value_chain.name: Titanium feed + carbon + chlorine → crude TiCl4
value_chain.description: KMML chlorinates beneficiated ilmenite in a fluidised-bed reactor. Impurity oxides also form chlorides, so the output is a mixture requiring cleanup. The feed specification affects both chloride production and the load on downstream purification.

value_chain.name: Crude TiCl4 → purified TiCl4 → pigment or sponge
value_chain.description: Distillation separates impurities. Oxidation produces TiO2 pigment; magnesium reduction produces titanium sponge and MgCl2. Metal-grade TiCl4 needs additional purification beyond the pigment intermediate. These two branches share an intermediate but deliver different products.

value_chain.name: Zircon → separated ZrO2 → ZrCl4 → zirconium sponge
value_chain.description: NFC’s route removes silica, dissolves Zr/Hf into nitric-acid solution, separates them with TBP, and makes purified ZrO2. Chlorination and Kroll reduction follow. Hafnium recovery is a separate product opportunity from the rejected stream, not a by-product automatically recovered by chlorinating zircon.

value_chain.name: Silicon metal → chlorosilanes → polysilicon → wafers
value_chain.description: Metallurgical silicon reacts with HCl to form trichlorosilane. Distillation purifies the intermediate; deposition produces polysilicon, followed by clean handling. Wafer and cell or chip manufacturing are further stages with their own specifications and equipment.

k07.summary: India's electrode industry supplies furnace engineering and carbon-processing experience. Battery anodes require a separate product chain: controlled powders, purification, coatings and qualification in customers' cells. Silicon–carbon composites are another extension, with additional materials and performance requirements.

what.text: Graphite is carbon arranged in stacked layers. In a lithium-ion battery, lithium moves into and out of those layers as the cell charges and discharges. Natural graphite starts in a mineral deposit; synthetic graphite starts with a carbon precursor that is heat-treated to create the required crystal structure. These are alternative feed routes into anode material, with different processing costs and environmental burdens.

Graphitisation is the very high temperature conversion of a suitable carbon precursor into graphite. India's experience making large graphite electrodes therefore provides useful furnace, power-management and raw-material skills. An electrode that conducts electricity into a steel furnace is nevertheless a different product from the fine active powder inside a battery. The industrial experience transfers; a finished electrode does not become qualified anode material merely by being crushed.

value_chain.name: Synthetic route: select and prepare the carbon
value_chain.description: Petroleum-derived coke is an established starting material. Feed preparation and heat treatment establish a carbon structure suitable for graphitisation. The precursor's impurities and behaviour during heating affect the product, so a furnace cannot compensate for arbitrary feedstock.

value_chain.name: Graphitise, purify and engineer the powder
value_chain.description: High temperature treatment develops the graphite structure; purification removes unwanted elements. Milling, particle control and surface treatment turn the material into an anode product. Epsilon's product range illustrates the deliberate engineering of graphite morphology rather than the sale of undifferentiated carbon.

value_chain.name: Natural route: concentrate, mill and purify
value_chain.description: Flake graphite is mined and concentrated, then processed into a clean, controlled powder. Chemical or thermal purification must be assessed together with wastewater and energy requirements. Natural and synthetic products can serve the same cell market, but their production flowsheets are different.

value_chain.name: Validate the material in a battery
value_chain.description: The powder must work in the customer’s electrode and complete cell. Syrah describes iterative testing with battery manufacturers and vehicle companies, alongside supply agreements. Capacity built, product sampled, product approved and regular commercial sales are separate milestones.

expansion.title: First: agree a product with a cell customer
expansion.text: A plausible Indian expansion would begin with one specified anode grade and a customer testing programme. Decide the feed route, targeted cell chemistry and approval criteria before choosing nameplate capacity. Use existing demonstration facilities to establish repeatability; an attractive powder sample alone is an insufficient basis for a large plant.

expansion.title: Then: demonstrate the complete production route
expansion.text: The proposed next step is to measure yield, electricity, reagent use, water treatment and off-spec production across connected operations. India's electrode companies offer industrial foundations, but dedicated powder-handling, cleanliness and cell-testing work still needs to be built around them. This is an expansion analysis, not a claim that every named company already provides those operations.

expansion.title: Scale approved grades; develop silicon composites separately
expansion.text: Expansion should follow reproducible customer-approved batches and purchase commitments. Silicon-containing grades can be developed alongside that base, with separate testing rather than assumed interchangeability. Partnership with an experienced silicon-material producer is a way to acquire the missing formulation and application knowledge; it does not remove the need for Indian production validation.

constraints.title: Power and environmental performance
constraints.text: Synthetic graphite is energy intensive. For the natural route, purification and reagent recovery matter alongside mining. A 2026 US pilot programme explicitly targets lower heat-treatment energy, reusable water and acid, and lower chemical waste; these are useful questions for an Indian feasibility study too.

constraints.title: Anode performance cannot be read from electrode tonnage
constraints.text: The relevant commercial evidence is a repeatable approved anode product and delivery record. HEG's electrode capacity and TACC's demonstration and planned anode capacities describe different products and development stages; adding those figures together would misrepresent supply.

k08.summary: Spent catalysts are concentrated secondary sources of useful metals. India already has industrial experience recovering molybdenum and other metals, alongside precious-metal refining. The opportunity is to connect traceable waste collection, selective recovery and customer-approved products, while distinguishing regeneration from destruction and metal recovery.

what.text: A catalyst accelerates a reaction while its active material cycles through the reaction rather than acting as a bulk consumable. Refinery hydrotreating uses metal-containing catalysts to help remove unwanted compounds from fuels. Topsoe's commercial portfolio includes nickel–molybdenum and cobalt–molybdenum formulations. After service, catalysts can retain valuable metals even when deposits or contamination make them unsuitable for continued use.

There are two different circular routes. Regeneration removes deposits and restores an existing catalyst for reuse where its condition permits. Metal recovery breaks down the spent material, separates its elements and produces fresh chemical or metallurgical feed. The right route depends on contamination, mechanical condition and performance testing. Recovering molybdenum, cobalt or nickel does not by itself manufacture a complete new catalyst or a battery-grade salt.

value_chain.name: Use, unload, sample and segregate
value_chain.description: The refinery generates spent material. Individual containers can differ in contamination, so representative sampling and segregation determine whether a batch is a candidate for regeneration or requires metals reclamation. The service begins before a chemical plant receives a mixed pile.

value_chain.name: Regenerate reusable material
value_chain.description: Controlled treatment removes carbon and sulphur deposits; catalyst activity and physical properties are then assessed. Eurecat offers regeneration and licensed rejuvenation services for several hydroprocessing catalyst families. This preserves the catalyst's embodied manufacturing work instead of immediately extracting its metals.

value_chain.name: Recover metals from exhausted material
value_chain.description: In Rubamin's described route, roasting precedes leaching and chemical separation. Solvent extraction or selective precipitation separates valuable elements from the mixed solution. Feed composition dictates the separation sequence; oil, sulphur and unwanted metals create treatment duties as well as recoverable value.

value_chain.name: Sell a specified chemical or alloy
value_chain.description: Rubamin lists ammonium molybdates, molybdenum trioxide and sodium molybdate among its products. Another valid route is AMG's production of nickel–molybdenum alloy for steelmaking. These are different endpoints: a steel alloy, a catalyst precursor and a battery chemical are not interchangeable products.

expansion.text: An Indian expansion could secure named refinery streams, establish independent sampling and agree whether the customer wants regenerated catalyst, molybdenum chemical or another product. However, a process demonstrated on one catalyst family should be revalidated before accepting chemically different feeds.

expansion.text: A further expansion could supply catalyst manufacturers with approved precursors or develop separately purified nickel and cobalt chemicals. That requires customer specifications and testing, not simply a higher advertised purity. constraints.text: A treatment plant processes metal plus support material, deposits and contaminants. Published waste-handling capacity cannot be reported as recovered-metal capacity. Rubamin's different capacity statements also need to retain their line and date context rather than being mechanically summed.

constraints.title: Recovery is not the same as final-product performance
constraints.text: The recovered material must suit its buyer. AMG's alloy route and Rubamin's chemical route demonstrate commercially meaningful but different outcomes. A project should evaluate revenues, refining cost and residue liabilities for the chosen endpoint; no universal margin or Indian capital-cost estimate follows from these examples.

k09.summary: Electronic and optical materials turn small quantities of very clean substances into high-value components. India has documented gallium and tellurium purification work and rare-earth-doped optical-fibre technologies. These are distinct chains: metal purity, semiconductor manufacture and fibre-device manufacture should each be assessed on their own evidence.

what.text: High-purity refining removes the last unwanted elements after bulk extraction. Six-nines or 6N purity denotes 99.9999% of the principal substance; 7N denotes 99.99999%. Which impurities remain also matters. Research on gallium-fed GaAs epitaxy shows that source purity can limit electronic performance even within a sophisticated crystal-growth system. A single headline purity figure is therefore an incomplete product specification.

Rare-earth-doped fibres are a different use of precision chemistry. Erbium or ytterbium ions are deliberately introduced into a glass core, where optical pumping allows amplification or laser emission. Their role is functional rather than that of an impurity. Erbium-based systems commonly operate around 1.55 micrometres and ytterbium systems around 1.06 micrometres. Making the fibre does not itself separate those elements from mined ore.

value_chain.name: Gallium: crude metal to purified source
value_chain.description: C-MET describes refining 4N gallium to 6N through hydrochemical cleaning, vacuum treatment, zone refining and fractional crystallisation. These methods exploit different impurity behaviours. The starting metal still needs to be supplied by an upstream recovery or recycling operation.

value_chain.name: Gallium: purified source to a semiconductor
value_chain.description: Purified gallium then enters compound-semiconductor and crystal-growth processes, followed by device manufacture. C-MET's purification description is evidence for one input capability; it does not establish an operating Indian commercial chain for GaAs wafers, GaN epitaxy or packaged devices.

value_chain.name: Tellurium: recovered metal to qualified electronic material
value_chain.description: C-MET documents high-purity tellurium work and offers 7N tellurium and cadmium technology for adoption. Downstream manufacturers can convert purified materials into compounds such as CdTe or CdZnTe; 5N Plus illustrates these distinct photovoltaic and detector product requirements.

value_chain.name: Rare earths: separated chemical to fibre and system
value_chain.description: An already separated rare-earth chemical is incorporated into a glass preform, drawn into active fibre and integrated into an amplifier or laser. Fibre structure and glass composition help determine performance. The finished system also needs optical pumping, components, packaging and application testing.

actors.name: C-MET, Hyderabad
actors.role: Development of ultrapurification processes for electronic materials.
actors.status: Documents a 4N-to-6N gallium route; its 14 November 2024 technology-adoption notice lists 7N tellurium and cadmium. These are process and transfer evidence, not a published current commercial gallium-output figure.
actors.evidence_date: 14 November 2024 notice; undated gallium page accessed 19 October 2026

actors.name: Nuclear Fuel Complex
actors.role: Special-materials and high-purity-materials capability within DAE.
actors.status: An official 2020 document lists gallium and tellurium among materials in a stated 99.999–99.9999% purity range. It is historical capability evidence; it supplies neither current mineral-specific output nor customer qualification data.

actors.name: CSIR-CGCRI and industrial collaborators
actors.role: Specialty active fibres, optical amplifiers and fibre-laser development.
actors.status: CGCRI records an Er amplifier commercial launch with NeST Photonics in August 2005 and development of a 1 kW Yb fibre laser with Sahajanand Laser Technology and Omega Innovation. Its September 2026 list separately labels commercialised fibres and transferred packaged-laser technology.
actors.evidence_date: 9 July 2025 development page; 29 September 2026 technology list

actors.name: 5N Plus
actors.role: Non-China benchmark for customer-specific semiconductor compounds.
actors.status: Commercial catalogue distinguishes CdTe for solar applications from higher-purity detector compounds such as CdZnTe, illustrating several markets beyond selling purified elemental tellurium.

mineral_links.how: Builds the purification bridge between recovered or purchased gallium and electronic-material users. The demonstrated refining route does not establish domestic recovery from Bayer liquor or an entire compound-semiconductor factory.
mineral_links.fit: Direct purification capability; scale and qualification require separate evidence

mineral_links.how: The connection is tellurium recovered as a copper-refining by-product, rather than improving copper cathode purity. Indian tellurium-recovery work at Birla Copper provides an upstream link; electronic purification and compound manufacture add separate downstream steps.
mineral_links.fit: By-product connection through tellurium

mineral_links.how: Converts separated rare-earth chemicals into active optical fibres and then amplifiers or lasers. It creates specialised domestic uses for small material volumes; it is not evidence that India already operates bulk extraction or separation of these heavy rare earths.
mineral_links.fit: Direct downstream use; upstream sourcing remains separate

expansion.title: Define a buyer's purity and performance specification
expansion.text: A credible expansion would start with a named electronic-material customer or fibre-system application. Specify the impurity limits, physical form, batch size and acceptance test. Improving a general purity number without understanding the buyer's process can produce a technically impressive but commercially unusable material.

expansion.title: Reproduce and qualify Indian batches
expansion.text: For purified metals, the proposed work is repeatable processing, trace analysis, contamination-controlled handling and comparison with an accepted reference. For active fibres, it is reproducible preforms, drawing and device tests. C-MET's transfer notice and CGCRI's technology statuses provide concrete starting points; an adoption notice should not be recast as a completed commercial expansion.

expansion.title: Connect recovery, materials and device partners
expansion.text: A possible tellurium chain would connect a copper-slime processor to a specialist refiner and then a qualified compound user. An Er/Yb chain could begin with imported separated chemicals while Indian firms scale fibres and systems. These are proposed partnership models: useful downstream manufacturing need not wait for every upstream operation to become domestic.

constraints.title: Laboratory capability and industrial supply are different
constraints.text: Historical C-MET reporting describes materials supplied for research needs. A current commercial claim needs repeated batch volumes and customer evidence. NFC's broad purity range likewise cannot be assigned to every listed element as a precise current specification.

constraints.title: Different products require different plants
constraints.text: An electronic metal refiner, compound-semiconductor manufacturer and fibre-system producer solve different problems. Public evidence for one should not imply the others. India's expansion is more assessable as several specific products with customers than as a single generic 'high-purity materials' capacity figure.

glossary.meaning: Moving a narrow molten region through material to redistribute and separate impurities.
A deliberately added element that gives a material a desired property.
A glass body made before it is drawn into optical fibre.

k10.summary: Hydrometallurgy dissolves and separates elements into useful products. India has process-development experience, pilot facilities and some industrial transfers. That foundation can support several mineral chains; each feed still needs its own validated flowsheet and commercial case.

what.text: Hydrometallurgy uses liquids to recover metals: dissolve selected components, remove impurities, separate elements and recover a product. A flowsheet specifies the sequence. IMMT develops these routes and basic engineering packages. Expertise transfers between projects; a single recipe does not work for every ore, slime or recycled powder.

Solvent extraction transfers selected dissolved species between a water-based liquid and an organic phase containing an extractant. Changing the chemical environment changes the separation. Primary research on rare-earth transport shows that even background anions can alter selectivity toward lighter or heavier elements. India's useful capability is therefore the ability to develop and integrate specific separations, rather than possession of a universal 'critical minerals' process.

value_chain.name: Characterise a specific feed
value_chain.description: Determine composition, mineral form and variability before selecting a route. Feeds containing the same element can require different treatment. BARC’s Dantala flowsheet combines flotation and chemical processing for a particular Rajasthan ore.

value_chain.name: Leach and remove the bulk impurities
value_chain.description: Dissolve targeted elements and remove undissolved solids. IMMT’s platform includes atmospheric and pressure leaching, precipitation and filtration. The design must retain target values while rejecting unwanted species.

value_chain.name: Separate mixed solutions into useful fractions
value_chain.description: Chemical separations create useful fractions. IREL’s 2021 compendium describes mixed-chloride refining at Aluva into selected rare-earth products. This provides a concrete precedent, but its historical product list does not establish today’s qualified output for every element.

value_chain.name: Recover a specified product and prove the plant
value_chain.description: Precipitation, crystallisation or electrolysis produces a chemical or metal. Pilot testing establishes a process package; industrial operation also requires reliable feed, utilities, treatment facilities and customers. IMMT distinguishes pilot studies from transferred routes.

actors.name: CSIR-IMMT
actors.role: Flowsheet development, pilot testing and basic engineering.
actors.status: Its technology profile reports a 10-tonne/day chromite-overburden proving plant and separately lists historical industrial transfers, including nickel recovery from refinery electrolyte and cobalt recovery from scrap. A proving-plant figure is not ongoing commercial output.

actors.name: CSIR-NML
actors.role: Research on metals recovery, secondary resources and recycling.
actors.status: The 2025-26 project list includes scandium separation from tin slag, NdFeB magnet recycling, battery-to-battery work and tellurium recovery from copper anode slime. Project entries document research scope and scheduled dates, not completed commercial plants.

actors.name: BARC
actors.role: Ore treatment, rare-earth processing and technology support within DAE.
actors.status: Its 2025 report describes a Dantala ore flowsheet recovering about 85% of rare-earth values as mixed oxalates, with separate pilot-scale materials work. Mixed oxalate recovery does not establish individual heavy-rare-earth separation.

actors.name: IREL, Rare Earths Division
actors.role: Commercial mixed-concentrate refining and selected rare-earth products.
actors.status: A 2025 government reply confirms operating extraction and refining facilities. IREL’s 2021 compendium records Nd–Pr, Sm, Dy, Gd and Y compounds at Aluva; historical catalogue inclusion does not establish present customer-qualified volumes.

mineral_links.how: The map connection concerns tellurium contained in copper anode slime. IMMT records recovery work at Birla Copper, while NML lists further selenium/tellurium process development. These are by-product opportunities attached to copper refining, not evidence of a new copper mine.
mineral_links.fit: Specific by-product route with historical transfer and current R&D evidence

mineral_links.how: Can recover these metals from selected scrap, spent catalysts, batteries and refinery streams. NML lists transferred nickel-catalyst recovery and developed battery-recycling routes; IMMT’s overburden evidence is pilot-scale. The final metal or salt specification needs separate proof.
mineral_links.fit: Demonstrated transfer for selected feeds; other routes remain developmental

mineral_links.how: Selective leaching and separation can investigate scandium-bearing residues. NML's register identifies a tin-slag project and a red-mud utilisation programme. Their existence supports a research link, not a claim that an Indian commercial scandium stream is already supplying customers.
mineral_links.fit: Research and scale-up opportunity

mineral_links.how: IREL’s historical product literature identifies Nd–Pr combined material and Sm, Gd and Y compounds. NML lists developed neodymium recovery from hard-drive waste. These are specific product precedents, not independent separation of every rare earth.
mineral_links.fit: Commercial foundation for listed products, with further development by route

mineral_links.how: IREL’s 2021 compendium lists dysprosium oxalate and oxide. This is a stronger precedent than generic R&D, but the source does not establish current throughput, feed provenance or qualification for a particular customer. Expansion needs fresh operating evidence.
mineral_links.fit: Historical product evidence; current qualified output unverified

mineral_links.how: These links identify potential applications of separation expertise to heavy rare earths. The reviewed sources do not establish commercial Indian supply of all six. Recovering a mixed rare-earth product still leaves element-by-element separation, yield and customer qualification to demonstrate.
mineral_links.fit: Research carry-over; commercial supply not established by these sources

expansion.title: Choose a feed-and-product pair
expansion.text: An expansion could select one secure waste stream and one buyer specification. Slime-to-tellurium, electrolyte-to-nickel and magnet recycling are separate projects. Establish the feed’s variability and the customer before designing a larger processing campus.

expansion.title: Run an integrated continuous pilot
expansion.text: The proposed next step is a connected campaign measuring recovery, quality, reagent recycling and residue behaviour across representative feeds. Shared pilot infrastructure can avoid rebuilding every experiment. Historical pilot success still needs reproduction with the actual commercial feed and specification.

expansion.title: Transfer the complete operating package
expansion.text: Transfer should include equipment design, analytical control, training, treatment facilities and customer trials. An industrial partner must own daily operating risk. IMMT’s transfer history provides a precedent; NML’s register explains why scheduled research should retain its research status until later milestones are demonstrated.

constraints.title: Recoverable chemistry is not automatically economic
constraints.text: A proposed business case must include reagent consumption, impurity rejection, recycle build-up and saleable yield. Successful extraction alone does not establish a viable plant. No universal capital cost or guaranteed Indian timeline follows from these research results.

constraints.title: Rare-earth feed composition determines the opportunity
constraints.text: A plant cannot make an absent element. BARC's mixed recovery and IREL's commercial product list address different feeds and endpoints; neither establishes a complete heavy-rare-earth chain. Any expansion proposal should state which elements enter, which leave as qualified products and where the remainder goes.
